blockingLoop.evidence: 'please clean the lint filter and wipe the moisture sensors near the door opening with a dry cloth' repeated verbatim in five consecutive replies

rationale: After the customer clarified, the assistant correctly identified the normal anti-crease phase, reassured that it is not a fault and gave the right pointer (manual, open the door / turn off), with no parts or escalation. However it never asked for the make/model or where to find it, guessed at non-existent 'Anti-Crease' and 'Options' buttons the customer twice said they did not have, and pasted the same unnecessary lint-filter/moisture-sensor instruction into every reply even after concluding it was normal behaviour. The homeowner got the right answer but through a repetitive, poorly tailored conversation.
